name: Maid
message: 「...Miss Ririmu.」

name: Maid
message: 「Miss Ririmu, it's almost time.」

name: Ririmu
message: （Ah, my next lesson is already about to start...）
The Tobe Family was a lineage of great landowners stretching back continuously to the Kamakura period. Its history was even older than that of the Suzakuin Family.
A grand mansion overlooking a Japanese garden on sprawling grounds. I was born into an environment far more privileged than that of most Japanese people.

name: Ririmu's Mother
message: 「Master Saionji, your koto teacher, is a very strict person. Make sure you learn properly.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Yes, Mother...」
Mom was already over forty when she gave birth to me.
Being their long-awaited heir, both Dad and Mom treasured me deeply.
Only... being treasured like that felt heavy to me.

name: Koto Teacher
message: 「...What are you doing, Miss Ririmu！ Play it just as I taught you before！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「But it sounds prettier this way...」

name: Koto Teacher
message: 「The classics only have meaning when you follow tradition. Until you understand the reasoning behind them, stay quiet and obey！」

name: Maid
message: 「Miss Ririmu, it's almost time. Your next lesson is traditional dance.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Haah... I'm already sleepy...」

name: Maid
message: 「Please bear with it. Your instructor is about to arrive.」
Ever since I was three, my days were spent on lessons from morning till night. The only time I could rest was for a brief moment before and after meals.
My parents genuinely believed that was love. That bestowing so much upon me would enrich my future life.
But it didn't resonate with me in the slightest.

name: Chauffeur
message: 「Have a pleasant day, Young Lady.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「...I'm off.」
I enrolled in a prestigious private elementary school for young ladies. It was a school my parents chose all on their own. I had no say in the matter.

name: Female Student
message: 「Why, good day, Lady Ririmu. Lovely weather we're having today, isn't it?」
As the only daughter of the wealthy landowning Tobe Family, I was held in high regard even among the other students.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Yes, it really is.」
To me, just a quiet, boring place with nothing fun about it.
Then, when the time came, I was chauffeured back and forth in a black luxury car, with studying and lessons waiting after school.
It truly was the picture-perfect life of a sheltered young lady.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Woaah... So pretty...！」
One day, I was taken to a sword exhibition.
I was instantly captivated by the dull gleam reflecting off the blades of the Japanese swords I saw there.

name: Ririmu's Father
message: 「We Tobe are a martial family now, after all. It’s important to cultivate an aesthetic eye by looking at things like this.」
That was the first time I felt grateful to my parents. I truly wanted to thank them for showing me something so beautiful.
I learned later that the sword exhibition had been hosted by the Sword-Bearing Self-Defense Association.
Perhaps that’s why there was a Jindou experience booth in one corner of the exhibition.

name: Ririmu
message: 「What’s that, I wonder...」
It was mostly aimed at children, intended to let them try out Jindou using safe Origami with blades covered in rubber coating.

name: Ririmu
message: 「...Father, Mother. May I try that？」

name: Ririmu's Father
message: 「Isn't it dangerous？」

name: Ririmu's Mother
message: 「My dear, it's good to experience everything.」
With my parents' permission, I held a sword for the very first time there.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Waaah...！」
The feeling of Tenju activating and strength flooding through my entire body. I will never forget the exhilaration of that moment for as long as I live.

name: Jindou Trainer
message: 「W-wow... young lady, that's an incredible mental resonance value！ You could aim to be a professional Jindou athlete one day！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Really...？」

name: Jindou Trainer
message: 「How about it, miss? Why don't you try practicing Jindou?」

name: Ririmu
message: 「...Yeah, I want to try.」

name: Ririmu's Father
message: 「Sir, please don't lead my daughter astray. I have no intention of turning her into a spectacle.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「But, Father... I want to try Jindou...」

name: Ririmu's Father
message: 「No. Give that sword back right now.」
I couldn't accept it.
Why can't I do anything? Why can't I even make my own decisions?
Why, why, why—

name: Ririmu's Father
message: 「Wh-what is this...！？」
Before I realized it, I had activated my Tenju and trapped Papa within my own illusion.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Why is my life just nothing but lessons every single day, with no time to play with my friends...？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Why am I never allowed to do anything...？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Why... why am I not allowed to decide anything for myself...！？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Why... hey, why...！」

name: Ririmu's Father
message: 「O-okay... I'm sorry, Ririmu...！ I get it, just stop...！」
――Because of things like that, my parents finally allowed me to pursue Jindou.
That said, it wasn't like the lessons I had been taking disappeared; Jindou was just added to the pile.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Well, that was fine too, I suppose.」
And thanks to that, I’m able to stand on this stage right now.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Alright then, time to go and give it a shot.」
